Axis.description: One axis of the table: a variable and the values it takes.

values.description: Values of the variable, in the variable's units, in the order of the table; at least one.

variable.description:
RFC 6901 JSON Pointer to a decimal input of the inner method, for example
`/discount_rate`.

ErrorReport.description: The report of an error: its stable code and a message in English.

code.description: Stable error code, for example `FM-E004` (see the errors reference).

message.description: What is wrong and, where known, how to fix it.

InnerMethod.description: The method an analysis evaluated, at the version actually run.

version.description: Method version run by this engine.

value.description: The output read from the inner result, in its units.

anyOf.description: The inner method returned this error; the rest of the request went on.

error.description: Code and message of the inner method's error.

Outcome.description: Outcome of one evaluation in a table or a scenario: a value, or the inner error (R16).

base.description: The output for `base_input` unchanged, in the output's units.

cells.description:
`cells[i][j]`: the output with the row variable at `rows.values[i]` and the column
variable at `columns.values[j]` (one column in a one-way table), as `{"value": ...}`, or
`{"error": {"code", "message"}}` when the inner method refused that combination.

columns.description: The column axis, as given; absent for a one-way table.

failed_cells.description: Number of cells holding an error.

inner_method.description: The method evaluated, at the version run.

output.description: The output pointer reported in each cell.
